hook: *15* big employers pledge to cut their vehicle use *10%* from 2027
hook_b: *15* big employers pledge to cut their vehicle use *10%* from 2027
tldr: At Cyberabad Police's 'Cyberabad Moves' launch at T-Hub, about 15 firms including Infosys, TCS, Cognizant, Tech Mahindra and LPL Financial pledged to cut vehicle use linked to their offices by 10% from 2027.

beats.what: About 15 corporates, including LPL Financial, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS and Tech Mahindra, pledged to cut vehicle use linked to their establishments by 10% from 2027.
beats.why: The pledge came at Cyberabad Moves, launched by DGP CV Anand on Thursday with the Cyberabad Municipal Corporation and SCSC, to tackle worsening traffic congestion.
beats.care: Firms pledged carpooling, public transport, better last-mile links, higher-capacity vehicles instead of cabs, hybrid work and company shuttle buses.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Companies told TOI they have already started shrinking cab fleets in the IT corridor.

facts.t: Traffic Police say *no* fine for solo car drivers has been proposed.
